```{r}

#Use the Wald test in DESeq2 for specific, pair-wise comparisons (e.g., Treatment vs. Control). Use the Likelihood Ratio Test (LRT) to test multiple groups simultaneously, particularly in multi-stage time-course experiments or when identifying genes that change across \(\ge 3\) conditions without predefined pairs.


library(readr)
library(dplyr)

counts_path  <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/Featurecounts/counts_featureCounts_updated.txt"
coldata_path <- "/Users/chhugani/coldata_clean_3.30.26.csv"

clean_sample_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- basename(x)
  x <- gsub("\r", "", x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- sub("\\.bam$", "", x)
  x <- sub("_sorted$", "", x)
  x <- sub("^HH0*", "", x)
  x
}

# Load counts
counts_raw <- read.delim(counts_path, check.names = FALSE)
counts_raw <- counts_raw[!grepl("^__", counts_raw$ID), ]

cts <- counts_raw[, -(1:6)]
gene_ids <- counts_raw$ID
colnames(cts) <- clean_sample_id(colnames(cts))

# Load coldata
coldata <- read.csv(coldata_path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(coldata) <- trimws(names(coldata))

coldata$Sample <- clean_sample_id(coldata$Sample)

# Match samples
common <- intersect(colnames(cts), coldata$Sample)

cat("Samples in counts:", ncol(cts), "\n")
cat("Samples in coldata:", nrow(coldata), "\n")
cat("Common samples:", length(common), "\n")

print(head(colnames(cts), 10))
print(head(coldata$Sample, 10))
print(head(common, 10))

# Keep and reorder counts
cts <- cts[, common, drop = FALSE]

# Keep and reorder coldata to match counts
coldata2 <- coldata %>%
  filter(Sample %in% common) %>%
  arrange(match(Sample, common))

stopifnot(identical(colnames(cts), coldata2$Sample))

# Save cleaned outputs
out_counts_clean  <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/DeSeq2/counts_clean.tsv"
out_coldata_clean <- "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/DeSeq2/coldata_clean.tsv"

cts_out <- as.data.frame(cts)
cts_out <- cbind(ID = gene_ids, cts_out)

write.table(cts_out, out_counts_clean, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.table(coldata2, out_coldata_clean, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

cat("Saved:\n", out_counts_clean, "\n", out_coldata_clean, "\n")
```

```{r}
# =========================
# Reload cleaned counts + coldata for DESeq2
# =========================

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(DESeq2)

# -------------------------
# 1) Load cleaned counts
# -------------------------
cts_df <- read.delim(
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/DeSeq2/counts_clean.tsv",
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Clean gene IDs
cts_df$ID <- trimws(gsub("\r", "", cts_df$ID))
cts_df <- cts_df[!is.na(cts_df$ID) & cts_df$ID != "", ]

# Make gene IDs unique if needed
cts_df$ID <- make.unique(cts_df$ID)

# Set rownames and make count matrix
rownames(cts_df) <- cts_df$ID
cts <- as.matrix(cts_df[, -1])

# DESeq2 wants integer counts
mode(cts) <- "numeric"
cts <- round(cts)
mode(cts) <- "integer"

# Remove genes with NA counts if any
cts <- cts[rowSums(is.na(cts)) == 0, ]

# -------------------------
# 2) Load cleaned coldata
# -------------------------
coldata <- read.delim(
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/KC_SAB_analysis_Nov_2025/DeSeq2/coldata_clean.tsv",
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Clean sample IDs
coldata$Sample <- trimws(gsub("\r", "", coldata$Sample))
rownames(coldata) <- coldata$Sample

# -------------------------
# 3) Clean metadata columns
# -------------------------
coldata$Status <- factor(coldata$Status)

coldata$Day_raw <- coldata$Day
coldata$Day <- trimws(as.character(coldata$Day))
coldata$Day <- gsub("[^0-9]", "", coldata$Day)
coldata$Day <- factor(coldata$Day, levels = c("1", "3", "5", "7"))

coldata$Subject <- factor(coldata$Subject)

# Check for missing Day or Status
cat("NA Day:", sum(is.na(coldata$Day)), "\n")
cat("NA Status:", sum(is.na(coldata$Status)), "\n")

if (sum(is.na(coldata$Day)) > 0) {
  print(coldata[is.na(coldata$Day), c("Sample", "Status", "Day_raw", "Subject")])
}

# Drop samples missing Day/Status
coldata <- coldata[!is.na(coldata$Day) & !is.na(coldata$Status), , drop = FALSE]

# -------------------------
# 4) Match counts and coldata
# -------------------------
cat("All coldata samples in counts?:", all(rownames(coldata) %in% colnames(cts)), "\n")

cts <- cts[, rownames(coldata), drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(colnames(cts), rownames(coldata)))

# -------------------------
# 5) Final checks
# -------------------------
dim(cts)
dim(coldata)

table(coldata$Status, coldata$Day)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# DESeq2 LRT + DEGreport trajectory clustering
# =========================

library(DESeq2)
library(DEGreport)

# Ensure factors are set correctly
coldata$Status <- factor(coldata$Status)
coldata$Day <- factor(coldata$Day, levels = c("1", "3", "5", "7"))

# Build DESeq2 object
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = cts,
  colData = coldata,
  design = ~ Status + Day + Status:Day
)

# Basic gene filter
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 3
dds <- dds[keep, ]

# Run LRT
dds_lrt <- DESeq(
  dds,
  test = "LRT",
  reduced = ~ Status + Day
)

# LRT results
resLRT <- results(dds_lrt)
summary(resLRT)

# Check model coefficient names for later contrasts
resultsNames(dds_lrt)

# -------------------------
# 1) Significant LRT genes
# Using raw p < 0.05 for exploratory trajectory clustering
# -------------------------
sig_LRT <- resLRT[!is.na(resLRT$pvalue) & resLRT$pvalue < 0.05, ]

sig_genes <- rownames(sig_LRT)
cat("Significant trajectory genes, raw p < 0.05:", length(sig_genes), "\n")

stopifnot(length(sig_genes) > 1)

# -------------------------
# 2) VST transform
# -------------------------
vsd <- vst(dds_lrt, blind = FALSE)
norm_mat <- assay(vsd)[sig_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# -------------------------
# 3) DEGreport clustering
# -------------------------
cluster_mat <- norm_mat
meta <- as.data.frame(colData(dds_lrt))

meta$Day <- factor(as.character(meta$Day), levels = c("1", "3", "5", "7"))
meta$Status <- factor(meta$Status)

clusters <- degPatterns(
  cluster_mat,
  metadata = meta,
  time = "Day",
  col = "Status"
)

# Gene-to-cluster mapping
head(clusters$df)

# Trajectory plot
clusters$plot
```
```{r}
#Resolving vs Persistent at each day

dds_wald <- DESeq(
  dds,
  test = "Wald"
)

resultsNames(dds_wald)

# Day 1
res_day1 <- results(
  dds_wald,
  name = "Status_Resolving_vs_Persistent"
)

# Day 3
res_day3 <- results(
  dds_wald,
  contrast = list(
    c(
      "Status_Resolving_vs_Persistent",
      "StatusResolving.Day3"
    )
  )
)

# Day 5
res_day5 <- results(
  dds_wald,
  contrast = list(
    c(
      "Status_Resolving_vs_Persistent",
      "StatusResolving.Day5"
    )
  )
)

# Day 7
res_day7 <- results(
  dds_wald,
  contrast = list(
    c(
      "Status_Resolving_vs_Persistent",
      "StatusResolving.Day7"
    )
  )
)
```

```{r}
day1_top <- day1_tbl[order(day1_tbl$pvalue), ][1:50, ]
day3_top <- day3_tbl[order(day3_tbl$pvalue), ][1:50, ]

library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(dplyr)

# Add Ensembl IDs without version numbers
day1_top$ensembl_id <- sub("\\..*", "", rownames(day1_top))
day3_top$ensembl_id <- sub("\\..*", "", rownames(day3_top))

# Collect unique IDs
all_top_ids <- unique(c(day1_top$ensembl_id,
                        day3_top$ensembl_id))

# Map Ensembl -> Gene Symbol
gene_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = all_top_ids,
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  columns = c("SYMBOL", "GENENAME")
)

# Remove duplicate mappings if any
gene_map <- gene_map[!duplicated(gene_map$ENSEMBL), ]

# Merge annotations back onto Day 1 results
day1_top_annotated <- merge(
  day1_top,
  gene_map,
  by.x = "ensembl_id",
  by.y = "ENSEMBL",
  all.x = TRUE
)

# Merge annotations back onto Day 3 results
day3_top_annotated <- merge(
  day3_top,
  gene_map,
  by.x = "ensembl_id",
  by.y = "ENSEMBL",
  all.x = TRUE
)

# Sort by p-value again
day1_top_annotated <- day1_top_annotated[
  order(day1_top_annotated$pvalue),
]

day3_top_annotated <- day3_top_annotated[
  order(day3_top_annotated$pvalue),
]

# View top genes
head(day1_top_annotated[, c("SYMBOL",
                            "GENENAME",
                            "log2FoldChange",
                            "pvalue",
                            "padj")], 20)

head(day3_top_annotated[, c("SYMBOL",
                            "GENENAME",
                            "log2FoldChange",
                            "pvalue",
                            "padj")], 20)

# Save
write.csv(
  day1_top_annotated,
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/day1_top50_genes_annotated.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  day3_top_annotated,
  "/Users/chhugani/Desktop/day3_top50_genes_annotated.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


#Positive log2FoldChange = Higher expression in Resolving patients
#Negative log2FoldChange = Higher expression in Persistent patients
```

```{r}
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(ggplot2)

# Full Day 1 table
day1_full <- as.data.frame(res_day1)
day1_full$ensembl_id <- sub("\\..*", "", rownames(day1_full))

day1_full <- merge(
  day1_full,
  gene_map,
  by.x = "ensembl_id",
  by.y = "ENSEMBL",
  all.x = TRUE
)

day1_full$label <- ifelse(
  day1_full$pvalue < 0.001 & abs(day1_full$log2FoldChange) > 1.5,
  day1_full$SYMBOL,
  ""
)

EnhancedVolcano(
  day1_full,
  lab = day1_full$label,
  x = "log2FoldChange",
  y = "pvalue",
  pCutoff = 0.05,
  FCcutoff = 1,
  title = "Day 1: Resolving vs Persistent",
  subtitle = "Positive = Resolving, Negative = Persistent",
  caption = "",
  pointSize = 2,
  labSize = 4,
  drawConnectors = TRUE,
  widthConnectors = 0.5,
  max.overlaps = 15,
  legendPosition = "none"

)


```
